profile.businessType: KCC is a Holding Company which invests in the Non-Performing Loans (NPL) and Non-Performing Asset (NPA) management business as a core business.
profile.address: 285/1 Praditmanutham Road, Wang Thonglang Subdistrict Wang Thonglang District Bangkok 10310
profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has dividend policy to pay dividend not less than 40.00 percent of net profits from operations after deducting corporate income tax and various reserves by laws and regulations of the company. However, the payment of such dividends may be subject to change depending on the investment plans, operational performance, financial status, liquidity, dividend payment policies of subsidiaries and/or affiliated companies, and other factors as deemed appropriate by the Board of Directors. Furthermore, dividends paid by the company shall not exceed the accumulated profits shown in the company's financial statements and shall comply with relevant laws and regulations.
